rows.text: The Kantei's retrospective page for the 77th Prime Minister, 海部俊樹, records the second Kaifu cabinet (第2次海部内閣) as formed on 平成2年2月28日 and lists 海部俊樹 as its Prime Minister (the cabinet was reshuffled on 平成2年12月29日).
